about: The shared FX magnitude cases (konsol #174 / konsolidat #176). The SAME list runs through konsol's konsol.group_rates.magnitude_verdict (test_group_exchange_rate.py) and konsolidat's dbt_project/tests/assert_fx_magnitude_cases.sql (fx_magnitude_problem). Keep them case for case. A reference of "nan" is NaN. expected: ok | implausible | no_reference | invalid.
rule: no reference: isNaN(usd_log10) OR (usd_log10 = 0 AND currency_code != 'USD'); invalid: rate not finite or <= 0 (checked first); implausible: abs(log10(rate) - (usd_log10(to) - usd_log10(from))) > 1

cases.note: true IDR (the old [1e-4, 1e4] band refused it)
exactly 1 decade off: refused only when > 1, never >= 1
